DECL	{"assumptions":[],"binders":["v"],"id":"NRS_484B_257_2_o2","intentions":[],"laws":["NRS-484B-257-2"],"narrowings":[{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"The clearance the duty keeps is written with prim.closest_approach_distance, which gives the distance between the two CENTRES at the closest approach under constant velocities within p.yield_conflict_horizon; no primitive gives that approach between the nearest points of the bodies. The duty therefore permits a passing in which two long bodies come closer than p.yield_min_clearance while their centres stay further apart, and the nearest-point figure rel.surface_gap measures is read where the record names it, in st2's qualification of an immediate hazard."},{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"The duty is read at every intersection the applicability's selection picks: the obligation quantifies universally over regions of kind st.intersection and rewrites that whole selection (the subject's footprint overlapping the junction, its moving, and a stop or yield sign at one of the junction's entrances) as the guard of the implication, since a region bound in the applicability is not in scope in the obligation."},{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"The approach carrier through which a protected vehicle reached the junction is read as a travel region other than the junction itself: a junction is no approach to itself, and st.lane_enters is not recorded on it, so reading the junction as its own entrance would leave the vehicle's obligation unknown wherever it stands in the junction."},{"kind":"reading","span":"st2","why":"The three figures of the hazard convention are read as alternatives: a vehicle is an immediate hazard where its ground distance to the junction is at most its own speed times p.yield_headway_time, or where the closest approach of the two centres within p.yield_conflict_horizon falls below p.yield_min_clearance, or where the nearest points of the two bodies are already closer than p.yield_min_clearance. The record states the distance figure and the conflict figure in one breath without saying which governs where, and either alone is enough to make the approach an immediate one."}],"operationalizations":[{"concepts":["kin.speed","prim.closest_approach_distance","prim.closest_approach_within","rel.occupies","st.intersection"],"params":["p.cautious_proceed_max_speed","p.yield_conflict_horizon","p.yield_min_clearance"],"standard":"and shall proceed cautiously","surrogate":false},{"concepts":["kin.speed","prim.closest_approach_distance","prim.closest_approach_within","rel.occupies","rel.surface_gap","st.intersection","st.lane_enters","st.region_geometry","st.travel_region"],"params":["p.yield_headway_time","p.yield_conflict_horizon","p.yield_min_clearance"],"standard":"or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard","surrogate":false}],"residues":["'although not a part of a through highway' adds no observable condition: it is concessive, saying that the cautious proceeding and the yielding are owed even where the junction is not part of a through highway, so the duty is the same whether or not it is. Reading it as a condition would make the rule apply only at junctions off a through highway, which is narrower than the words."],"surrogate":false}
